messages:
alex_dev: Hey — dropping the runtime profiling dump here. We saw a 2.4x p95 increase on route=/v1/generate yesterday after the kernel selector change. Can we add per-route dashboards showing token-level latency breakdowns (p50/p95/p99), throughput (tokens/s), error rate, and kv hit behavior?

opsbot: Automated profile uploaded: /mnt/profiles/1746843208/summary.json

jin_reliability: Noted. The spike aligns with the new kernel fallback rules. Suspect kernel_exec + scheduling queue increased. Need to attribute latency to stages: receive -> scheduling/queue -> kernel_exec -> kv_lookup -> postprocess -> network.

maya_ml: Agree. For dashboards we'd want both aggregated and per-model-variant views. Suggest labels: route, model, model_variant, kernel, quantized, batch_size, seq_len_bucket, kv_hit.

sam_platform: Minimal overhead is key. We should emit cheap counters always and sampled histograms for detailed breakdowns (e.g., 1% full traces, 100% stage counters). Also emit per-token counters so dashboards can show token-level latency.

alex_dev: Example metric names I'm proposing (Prometheus style):

- redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route,model,kernel}
- redwood_runtime_request_stage_seconds_sum{stage,route,model,kernel}
- redwood_runtime_request_stage_seconds_count{stage,...}
- redwood_runtime_tokens_processed_total{route,model}
- redwood_runtime_kv_lookup_seconds_sum{kv_hit,route,model}
- redwood_runtime_batch_size_distribution{route,model}
- redwood_runtime_errors_total{route,error_type}

maya_ml: A couple of quick PromQLs we can use in Grafana/Console panels:

1) p95 latency per route:
  histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

2) token-level avg latency (seconds/token) per route:
  rate(redwood_runtime_request_stage_seconds_sum{stage="kernel_exec"}[5m]) / rate(redwood_runtime_tokens_processed_total[5m])

3) stage breakdown (stacked area):
  sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_stage_seconds_sum[5m])) by (stage, route)

4) KV hit ratio per route:
  sum(rate(redwood_runtime_kv_lookup_seconds_count{kv_hit="true"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(redwood_runtime_kv_lookup_seconds_count[5m])) by (route)

jin_reliability: For p99 we should sample only 100% for a short window or use tail-sampled histograms. Also surface batch_size and seq_len distribution next to latency panels — heavy seq_len shifts will skew p95.

leah_product: Product ask: make it easy for customers to filter by route and see p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, error rate, and kv-hit. Also a heatmap of p95 by time-of-day (30min bins). Ensure the Console shows recommended reasons for regressions (e.g., kernel fallback, large seq_len, low kv_hit).

sam_platform: UI/implementation notes: expose a per-route KPI page with the following panels:
- Latency summary: p50/p95/p99 (line)
- Token throughput: tokens/s and requests/s (line)
- Stage stacked breakdown (area) — normalized to seconds/token and absolute seconds
- Error rate (5m windows) and top error_types table
- Batch size & seq_len distribution histograms
- KV hit ratio (bar + trend)
- Correlation scatter: batch_size vs p95

alex_dev: We also need alerts:
- route_p95_latency > SLO (configurable) for > 5m
- tokens/s drop by >30% for a route
- kv_hit ratio < 70% for > 10m (for routes that rely on caching)

maya_ml: Implementation detail: tag kernel name and fallback reason in traces, e.g., kernel="triton_v2", fallback="shape_mismatch". That will let Console show "likely cause: kernel fallback" on the regression card.

jin_reliability: Perf regression diagnostics plan:
1) Add the stage counters and kernel label (low overhead).
2) Add sampled histograms for 1% of requests capturing full stage timing + trace id.
3) Re-run the synthetic traffic for the failing route with seq_len distribution from production for 24h.
4) Compare kernel selection histogram before/after.

devex-bot: Note: add docs + SDK exposure for the new metric labels so customers can query in Console dashboards. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/789

sam_platform: Concern: counters for per-token may be heavy at 100% — propose tokens_processed_total per-request (size = tokens) instead of emitting per-token metrics.

alex_dev: Good call. Use tokens_processed_total and divide in PromQL.

leah_product: Timeline request: Can we get MVP in Console for a single tenant (internal) by next Tue? We can use it to demo to Sales.

jin_reliability: I'll instrument the runtime and send a diff by EOD Fri. Will add kernel and stage labels as counters (low overhead). For sampled histograms I'll add a runtime flag to set sample_rate.

maya_ml: I'll prepare dashboard JSON (Grafana-style) + PromQL snippets for Console panels. Will include examples for per-route filters and timeframe heatmap.

sam_platform: I'll add alert rules and a canary pipeline to verify metrics correctness before enabling customer-facing Console panels.

alex_dev: Action items summarized:
- jin_reliability: implement counters + kernel labels + sample histograms (due Fri)
- maya_ml: dashboard JSON + PromQL panels (due Mon)
- sam_platform: alerts + canary verification (due Mon)
- devex-bot/docs: SDK + docs PR (linked above)

leah_product: Thanks team :party-popper: 

opsbot: profile diff uploaded: /mnt/profiles/1746843208/diff/kernel-change-1746843208.json

alex_dev: ACK — will follow up in this thread with regression triage after instrumentation lands.
